sovereign_country.strategic_role: 全球跨境基金设立第一大国、超大型跨国投资架构

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Fast-Casual Self-Serve Broth Bowl Master Licensing

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Agreement between the People's Republic of China and the Belgium-Luxembourg Economic Union on the Encouragement and Reciprocal Protection of Investments (signed 4 June 1984, in force 24 April 1986)

Convention between the People's Republic of China and the Grand Duchy of Luxembourg for the Avoidance of Double Taxation and the Prevention of Fiscal Evasion with respect to Taxes on Income and on Capital (signed 14 March 1994, in force 21 July 1996)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law of 12 November 2004 on the fight against money laundering and terrorist financing, as amended; Law of 13 January 2019 establishing the central register of beneficial owners (RBE); Grand-Ducal Regulation of 28 July 2019; CSSF Regulation 12-02 on anti-money laundering, as amended; implementation of EU AML Directives 4/5/6.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized special power of attorney for the incorporation agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the People's Republic of China

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy and notarized certificate of incorporation of corporate shareholder (parent company), including articles of association and directors' register
Certificate of Good Standing (corporate registry extract) of the corporate shareholder or UBO's operating company
Recent bank reference letter for the beneficial owner and/or corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Commercial bank of the UBO or corporate shareholder in China
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization if bank refuses apostille

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Criminal record certificate / police clearance certificate of the proposed manager and UBO
Notarized copy of passport of the UBO, proposed manager and authorized signatories
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport authority of the People's Republic of China
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization in China plus Hague Apostille (alternatively consular legalization if required by receiving bank)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening against Luxembourg Financial Intelligence Unit (CRF) guidelines, EU Council Regulation (EC) No. 2580/2001 and CFSP financial sanctions lists, UN Security Council consolidated sanctions list, OFAC SDN list, Interpol red notices, and domestic adverse media checks for politically exposed persons (PEPs). Screening must be completed prior to engagement and refreshed periodically or upon any transaction trigger, with audit trail retained for five years.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) electronic filing platform (www.lbr.lu)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names may only be expressed in Latin characters (A-Z, a-z, 0-9 and permitted diacritics); foreign-language names must be phonetically transliterated into Latin script; Chinese characters are not accepted in the registry. The name must contain the legal form suffix 'Société à Responsabilité Limitée' or 'SARL' to denote limited liability. Names must be distinctive, not contrary to public order, and must not contain terms implying misleading character.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Within one month of receiving a name rejection notification from the LBR, the applicant shall file a formal written request for reconsideration with the LBR, including the original application reference and documentary justification; a commensurate administrative fee applies. If the reconsideration is denied, the applicant may file a 'Recours en annulation' with the Luxembourg Administrative Tribunal (Tribunal administratif) within 30 days of the notice of denial, mandatorily represented by a Luxembourg law firm. An interim suspension ('sursis à exécution') may be applied for in urgent circumstances.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual office addresses are not permissible for a licensed fast-casual food franchise restaurant. A physical commercial location in Luxembourg with a valid lease and ALVA (Administration luxembourgeoise vétérinaire et alimentaire) food-safety approval is mandatory. The registered office must be a physical address in Luxembourg where statutory books and corporate documents are kept; a purely virtual address without a dedicated physical office cannot meet commercial substance requirements for this industry.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notary public fees for drafting and authenticating the articles of association (statuts) of the SARL
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary Chamber of Luxembourg / licensed notary notarizing the deed
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff per Grand-Ducal Regulation (tarif notarial); prevailing market benchmark EUR 2,500-4,500 depending on complexity and share capital

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Company registry registration fee (RCS - Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés) for incorporation filing
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Fixed administrative fee published by LBR (approx EUR 75-100)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Publication fee in the Recueil électronique des sociétés et associations (RESA) — official corporate gazette
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Mémorial C / Imprimerie Nationale (official gazette service)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory publication charge (approx EUR 150-250 depending on length of text and number of pages)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Translation, notarization and apostille/certification bundle for Chinese corporate and personal documents (passports, parent company CR/Articles, POA, bank reference, criminal records)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Certified translation agencies in Luxembourg; Chinese notary offices; Ministry of Foreign Affairs of China or Luxembourg apostille authorities
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market rates: EUR 15-30 per page for translation; CNY 200-500 per notarization; apostille fee CNY 50 per document in China (or EUR 22 per document in Luxembourg); agency handling costs prevailing market

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Legal professional fees for AML/UBO due diligence, corporate drafting, and coordination with notary and registry
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Luxembourg law firm / regulated corporate services provider
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark: hourly rates EUR 250-450, with capped fixed engagement fees EUR 3,000-5,000 for standard SARL incorporation

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Bank account pre-incorporation due diligence and onboarding support bundle (UBO/PEP checks, documentation processing)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Luxembourg credit institution (bank) or third-party corporate service provider
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market rate for residency, AML/KYC and onboarding assistance; may be partially waived by bank as a client acquisition incentive

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name availability pre-clearing fee and application processing
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory or published LBR fee (approx EUR 35-55) for electronic name search and clearance

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Luxembourg Law of 10 August 1915 on Commercial Companies as consolidated (Articles 100-1 to 100-220 for Société à Responsabilité Limitée); Civil Code Article 1832 et seq.; Grand-Ducal Regulation of 23 January 2003 on the Luxembourg Business Registers.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers (Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés – RCS Luxembourg)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Notarial deed of incorporation (acte constitutif) with coordinated articles of association (statuts coordonnés)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: Minimum subscribed capital EUR 12,000. Full cash payments must be deposited into a blocked escrow account in the name of the company in formation, with funds released only upon RCS registration. At least EUR 12,000 paid-up capital must be evidenced by a bank certificate presented to the notary.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: Written resolution of the sole shareholder of [•] SARL, dated [date]: 1. Subscribes EUR 12,000 share capital, composed of [•] shares with a par value of EUR [•] each, fully subscribed and paid up to the minimum statutory threshold. 2. Adopts the Articles of Association in final form and authorizes their filing with the Luxembourg Business Registers. 3. Establishes the registered office at [address], Grand Duchy of Luxembourg. 4. Appoints [Name] as sole manager (gérant) with full powers of daily administration and representation; and [Name] as alternate manager. 5. Instructs the manager to complete the RCS registration, cause publication in Mémorial C, and take all steps to obtain the required food-service establishment licence.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name reservation and drafting of articles of association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers (RCS) – online pre-registration portal and notary public
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File a name reservation request via the RCS online platform, verify the availability of the proposed company name, and engage a Luxembourg notary to draft the statutory articles of association reflecting SARL requirements, share structure, and corporate purpose, including restaurant operation and franchise licensing.
required_dossiers: Identity documents of shareholders and managers
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected for conflict, submit an amended name with distinctive additional elements and re-file the reservation request.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Escrow deposit and notarial deed signing
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg notary public and a Luxembourg bank or Caisse de Consignation
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a blocked escrow account in the company's name, deposit the full minimum capital contribution of EUR 12,000 (or approved equivalent), obtain a bank deposit certificate, then execute the notarial deed of incorporation and articles of association before a Luxembourg notary, who verifies legal capacity and capital compliance.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary identifies deficiencies in the capital payment, arrange for supplemental deposit or amend the capital schedule and resign the deed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing with the RCS and lex formalities
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the notarial deed, articles of association, proof of registered office, and manager acceptance declarations to the RCS. Pay the statutory filing fee. RCS verifies legality and assigns the corporate registration number (RC number), completing the company's legal existence.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Respond to RCS queries by filing a supplementary memorandum or rectification deed within 15 days, and re-submit with corrections.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Official Journal of the Grand Duchy of Luxembourg (Mémorial C) and Luxembourg Tax Administration (Administration des contributions directes – ACD)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Publish the mandatory legal excerpt in Mémorial C. Following publication, ACD automatically allocates the national tax number and corporate income tax file; VAT registration is completed via the RCS/ACD electronic interface for commercial activity. Apply separately for food-service permits with the relevant ministries.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If Mémorial publication is delayed, contact the Official Journal service and provide proof of RCS filing; if tax registration fails, submit a direct request to the ACD Luxemburg office with company certificate and RCS excerpt.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of the Economy – General Directorate for Small Business (Direction générale des classes moyennes)
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Commercial establishment authorization (Autorisation d'établissement) under the Law of 2 September 2011; food-service operating permit (agrément alimentaire) issued by the Luxembourg Food Safety Administration (ALVA)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category B – simplified environmental notice (déclaration) applicable to small-scale fast-casual food preparation; full EIA not required for restaurants under 100 seats
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater discharge must comply with municipal sewer ordinance COD/BOD limits; installation and maintenance of an approved grease trap; food waste handled by licensed waste contractors; ventilation and VOC emissions adhere to Grand-Ducal Regulation on ambient air quality and occupational exposure thresholds.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate from the Commune Fire Prevention Service confirming compliance with sprinkler/extinguisher regulations; structural load inspection certificate by a certified engineer; occupational health and safety clearance from the Labour and Mines Inspectorate (ITM) covering food-preparation equipment and workplace ergonomics.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Luxembourg Inland Revenue (Administration des contributions directes, ACD) for direct taxes; Luxembourg Registration Duties, Estates and VAT Authority (Administration de l'enregistrement, des domaines et de la TVA, AEDT) for VAT; single digital portal: MyGuichet.lu
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign entity establishing a Luxembourg SARL must execute a notarized deed of incorporation, file it with the Luxembourg Trade and Companies Register (RCS), and subsequently obtain a national tax identification number (Numéro d'identification) from the ACD. VAT registration is then required with the AEDT, supported by the RCS extract, statutes, identity documents of directors and shareholding declarations. Non-resident shareholders may be required to evidence their own tax identification and beneficial ownership; the SARL's registered office and local director appointments must be in place before TIN/VAT-ID issuance.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Luxembourg does not operate a US-style check-the-box regime. Available statutory elections include the election for VAT grouping (assujetti unique), the election for group taxation / fiscal integration (intégration fiscale) for resident corporate taxpayers, and the application of participation exemption for qualifying shareholdings. Hybrid mismatch outcomes are neutralized under EU ATAD provisions transposed into Luxembourg law.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (Taxe sur la valeur ajoutée, TVA)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: EUR 35,000 annual turnover threshold for the small business exemption; however, non-established taxable persons supplying taxable goods or services in Luxembourg are required to register for VAT regardless of turnover threshold.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Luxembourg does not currently operate a real-time fiscal clearance or digital stamping regime. Electronic invoices are legally recognized if authenticity, integrity and readability are ensured. E-invoicing is mandatory for B2G transactions through the PEPPOL network under EU Directive 2014/55/EU. National B2B e-invoicing obligations are not yet generally mandated, but Luxembourg is aligning with the EU VAT in the Digital Age (ViDA) framework, which will impose structured e-invoicing for domestic B2B transactions in the coming years.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of goods supplied to non-EU (third-country) destinations qualify for 0% VAT where the exporter retains documentary evidence of dispatch or transport outside the EU, including a customs export declaration accepted by customs authorities. Intra-Community supplies are zero-rated only if the customer is a VAT-registered business with a valid EU VAT identification number and the goods are transported to another Member State. Services physically performed on goods destined for export and certain ancillary services may be zero-rated; franchise royalties and general management services to customers established abroad are subject to the place-of-supply rules and may be taxable where the customer resides.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Bill of Lading / Air Waybill / CMR transport document
Inward Remittance Certificate / Proof of Payment
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Fraudulent or insufficiently substantiated export zero-rating triggers a retrospective VAT assessment for the statutory limitation period (generally 5 years), plus late-payment interest. Administrative penalties can reach up to 100% of the underdeclared VAT, and serious fraud may result in criminal prosecution with fines and imprisonment. The Luxembourg tax authorities may also recharacterize sham transactions and hold the VAT representative jointly liable.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque centrale du Luxembourg (BCL), together with the Commission de Surveillance du Secteur Financier (CSSF) as the prudential and AML/CTF supervisor; BCL acts within the Eurosystem framework.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The euro is fully convertible in Luxembourg. Both current and capital account payments are free under Article 63 TFEU; there are no exchange control permits or profit-remittance delays. Only statistical reporting (Balance of Payments) to the BCL and bank AML explanations are required, e.g., dividend, royalty, or loan-repayment remittances.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No surrender or mandatory conversion of export receivables or trade proceeds exists in Luxembourg. Foreign-currency receipts may be retained, transferred, or converted freely, subject only to standard bank compliance and BCL statistical classification.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium to Low as sole banking solution. CSSF-regulated electronic money institutions (EMIs) may provide EUR IBANs and cross-border payment services, but a Luxembourg SARL ordinarily requires a licensed commercial bank for notarised capital subscription blocking, corporate treasury, and tax-administration credibility. An EMI is viable as a payment-completion or settlement-support rail for point-of-sale or small royalty flows, not as the primary treasury bank.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: EU directors and authorised local agents can complete onboarding via video identification and remote e-signature. Non-EU Chinese shareholders or managers normally must appear physically before the bank's compliance officer or provide certified/consularised passport and proof-of-address copies; in practice, leading banks such as BGL BNP Paribas and BIL require a final in-branch or video-interview confirmation by the UBO and a local director before account activation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border ownership from mainland China (subject to enhanced due diligence for non-FATF-jurisdiction ultimate beneficiaries).
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Parent company audit report for the last two years; RCS and share-register abstracts of the Chinese group with English notarised translation; UBO registry certificate and identity documents; source-of-wealth statement for the investment; bank reference letters from the remitting Chinese bank; a corporate organisational chart from the Chinese company registry; and a signed Luxembourg counsel opinion on the beneficial ownership and corporate purpose.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cash-intensive fast-casual food business model, creating a potential money-laundering exposure through repeated point-of-sale cash deposits.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: A cash management and cash-recycling policy approved by the board; POS acquiring agreement with a CSSF-licensed payment institution; average daily cash volume forecast; internal treasury reconciliation procedure; employee cash-handling segregation; annual external audit undertaking; and evidence of all applicable Luxembourg catering and health-safety licences.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Pre-registration capital contribution from a non-resident corporate shareholder to the SARL's blocked capital account.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarial draft deed of incorporation; bank certificate issued by the Luxembourg bank for the capital blocked account; SWIFT MT103 or evidence of the wire from the beneficial owner's account with detailed remittance purposes; notarised board/shareholder resolution approving the subscription; UBO declaration form; certificate of source of funds from a Luxembourg audit firm; and the legal opinion of the Luxembourg notary on capital adequacy and payment compliance under the Law of 10 August 1915.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: All equity and shareholder-loan injections are routed by SWIFT MT103 from the Chinese parent bank to the SARL's blocked or operational EUR account in Luxembourg. The wire message must contain the BCL Balance-of-Payments purpose code 'S302' (direct investment – equity) or 'S320' (intercompany loan) in the remittance field /70 (or the equivalent BCL statistical reporting annex). For pre-registration capital, the beneficiary is the notary's Luxembourg blocked escrow account or the bank's blocked capital account; remittance details must state 'Capital subscription – SARL incorporation' and the bank certificate is used to obtain the RCS registration. The bank will verify source of funds and the UBO, and may request a copy of the draft articles of association and the notary's instructions before crediting the blocked account.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Royalty, distribution, and operating payments are cleared via SEPA credit transfer for EUR-denominated outflows, or via SWIFT MT103 for cross-border, non-EUR payments (especially CNY/USD). For import sourcing of equipment and ingredients, commercial letters of credit (UCP600) are issued through acceptance at a Luxembourg bank, with MT700 for issuance and MT103/MT202 after document compliance. Payments to China must include the SAFE-mandated Chinese purpose code for royalty or trade and supporting contract registration documents. Local restaurant settlements flow from the acquirer to the Luxembourg operating account via ordinary SEPA clearing; no surrender requirement applies.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Vanilla EUR/CNH FX Forward (deliverable or non-deliverable)
Non-Deliverable Forward (NDF) on CNH using an offshore fixing rate when physical delivery of CNY to an onshore Chinese account is impossible

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual financial statements (comptes annuels) filed with the RCS; approval by shareholders in ordinary general meeting
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS), Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For fiscal year ending 31 December: shareholders' meeting and approval by 30 June; RCS filing within one month after approval, in practice by 31 July
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file triggers RCS notice; the district court may impose a penalty payment (astreinte) of up to EUR 5,000; continued default may lead to court-ordered dissolution and strike-off from the RCS.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual confirmation of beneficial owners in the Luxembourg RBE register (declaration annuelle des beneficiaires effectifs)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registre des Bénéficiaires Effectifs (RBE), Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within one month after the anniversary of the initial RBE filing or last annual confirmation; any shareholding transfer must be declared within one month of the transfer
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late or inaccurate filing exposes the SARL and its managers to administrative fines up to EUR 5,000 and public-prosecutor referral; continued non-compliance causes adverse AML/KYC status but not direct RCS strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate direct-tax return (Form 1000 for corporate income tax and municipal business tax; Form 1001 for net wealth tax)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Administration des contributions directes (ACD) via eCDF electronic filing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For a 31 December year-end, file by 31 December of the following calendar year unless the tax office sets an earlier individual deadline
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing triggers monthly late-payment interest of 0.6%; the ACD may impose procedural fines and issue an estimated assessment; unpaid taxes are enforced as tax receivables, not by RCS strike-off.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory audit for a SARL exceeding at least two of the three criteria for two consecutive financial years: balance-sheet total over EUR 6,000,000; net turnover over EUR 12,000,000; average workforce over 50 employees. A statutory audit may also be required by shareholder request in defined cases.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Annual statutory accounts are prepared under Luxembourg GAAP as codified by the Law of 19 December 2002 and related implementing regulations; consolidated or public-interest accounts may use IFRS as adopted by the EU.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Annual RBE confirmation is mandatory. Any transfer of SARL shares requires an immediate update of the share register and a change declaration to the RBE within one month. The annual confirmation serves as a compliance check that the declared ultimate beneficial ownership structure remains accurate.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Minute Book (ordinary and extraordinary general meetings and management resolutions)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: US$4,000 - US$10,000 if audit threshold triggered

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 24.94% aggregate (Luxembourg-City composite: 17% CIT above EUR 200,000 + 7% solidarity surcharge + 6.75% municipal business tax; 22.80% on the first EUR 200,000 bracket at 15% CIT)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: 80% participation exemption (dividends/qualifying capital gains), EU Patent Box/IP regime (80% income exempt → effective 5.2-6.7% aggregate), SICAR/group relief availability, R&D super-deduction, family/SME? not relevant; malatang franchise uses passive royalty stream; ensure substance. Net wealth tax 0.5% on net assets > EUR 500,000 (subject to SME exemption...)

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 500 (Déclaration pour l'impôt sur le revenu des collectivités et l'impôt commercial communal) together with Form 501 (Impôt sur la fortune) and CbCR/TP annexes; filed electronically through the Luxembourg e-filing portal MyGuichet.lu/ACD (Administration des contributions directes).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: 31 December of the calendar year following the tax year (e.g., FY 2024 return due 31 December 2025); payment of balance due typically within one month of assessment

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Entity identification: name, RCS number, ELF code, address, tax office (bureau d'imposition) 6?
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: SARL remains the filer; ultimate Chinese shareholder identified only in beneficial-ownership schedules, not as taxpayer; attach power of attorney if a Luxembourg tax agent signs.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Fiscal year opening/closing dates and accounting currency
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use EUR; if parent retains CNY records, provide certified translation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Restated commercial net profit before tax per Luxembourg GAAP
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No non-resident adjustment; SARL accounts include all global revenue of LU entity only.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Re-integers/écart fiscal: disallowed expenses, tax-indifferent reserves, TP corrections
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Ensure intercompany franchise master-license/fee invoices are arm's length and documented; non-resident parent charging brand royalties is disregarded for this box.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deductions, exempt income (80% participation exemption, IP box, losses carried forward up to 5 years)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach holding participation annexe, TRC, and substantive evidence.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income computation: CIT base, allocation of municipal business tax base (multiplication coefficient 3?)
Tax credits and advance payments already made
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: n/a - SAC credits? not applicable to SARL

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: CbCR/Master File/Local File identification where threshold met (group revenue ≥ EUR 750m / related-party transactions > EUR 1m)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Parent in China must submit TRC and provide group consolidation schedules; local agent files annexes.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: administrative astreinte up to EUR 2,500 plus 0.8% per month late-payment interest; ex officio (taxation d'office) reassessment; refusal to accept loss carryforward until return filed; criminal threshold for deliberate fraud.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 15% domestic rate on Luxembourg-sourced dividends (deducted at source by the SARL payer); 0% where the EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive applies (≥10% hold? >? see below) or where an 80% participation exemption.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To invoke the China-Luxembourg DTA (1983) dividend article: (1) obtain an annual Luxembourg? Actually TRC from Chinese competent authority (State Taxation Administration issuance in their paper; both treaties require demonstration residence), (2) Provide the Luxembourg paying SARL with the TRC and Beneficial Ownership Declaration before the distribution record date; (3) SARL applies the 5% rate if the Chinese beneficial owner is a company controlling directly ≥25% of SARL capital (else 10%); (4) any excess WHT refund claimed from ACD within statutory claim window; the payer must re-file or apply through Form 500 correspondence; treaty relief is denied absent substance.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Domestic WHT: 0% for interest and 0% for IP royalties paid by a Luxembourg SARL to a Chinese licensor/lender (no Luxembourg source WHT). Treaty (PRC-LU DTA): source-State cap 10% on interest and royalties, effectively moot for Luxembourg-source payments since domestic rate is nil; substance and beneficial ownership still required if China claims source tax.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Master File/CbC Report: MNE group consolidated revenue ≥ EUR 750,000,000 (EU Directive 2016/881). Local File: from FY 2023, required where related-party transactions in a category exceed EUR 1,000,000 per year, with SME (250 employees or turnover ≤ EUR 50m) exemption; the ACD may nonetheless demand full OECD TP documentation for any related-party flow under Art. 56bis LIR.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Luxembourg applies substance doctrine not via a standalone ESR code but via POEM, beneficial-ownership jurisprudence, LIR Art. 56bis, the 2022 Circular on outbound dividend benefits (requiring premises, staff, business activity, and independent discretion), ATAD CFC rules, and GAAR Art. 6 Steueranpassungsgesetz; a passive brand-licensing SARL without substantive board decisions, local staff, and risk control will be denied treaty/participation benefits and reallocated income to the Chinese principal.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Falsifying invoices, concealment of revenue of the malatang/franchise royalty activity, or false thresholds.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under Steueranpassungsgesetz and Criminal Code: fines up to EUR 25,000 per offense plus 0.8% monthly late-payment interest and 10% fiscal penalty? ...
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors face joint restitution for the suppressed tax, implementation ban, travel restrictions, criminal imprisonment up to 5 years...
